entities.summary: New In Chess (NIC) is a chess magazine that appears eight times a year with editors such as the Grandmaster Jan Timman and chess journalist Dirk Jan ten Geuzendam. It began publication in 1984 and contains game notes by top players and chess prodigies about their own games. Typical contributions are from players such as Anish Giri, Vladimir Kramnik, Viswanathan Anand, Péter Lékó, Judit Polgár and Magnus Carlsen. Since 2023 Remmelt Otten is editor-in-chief.
